tokens.name: bg-000
tokens.usage: Outside the slide container and the deepest corners of the vignette.

tokens.name: bg-100
tokens.usage: Slide ground: the deep black-navy every slide sits on.

tokens.name: bg-200
tokens.usage: Card surface: text cards, option rows, stat cards, comparison blocks.

tokens.name: bg-300
tokens.usage: Raised card or hovered/active row; bar-track fill in confidence charts.

tokens.name: glow
tokens.usage: Radial screen-light glow only, never a flat fill. Upper-left behind the headline, or behind the central object. Fades to bg-100.

tokens.name: line-100
tokens.usage: Background technical grid, dotted grid and coordinate lines. Barely visible by design — decoration, not information.

tokens.name: line-200
tokens.usage: Card borders (1px), divider lines between header/footer and content.

tokens.name: line-300
tokens.usage: Emphasised thin blue frame: active step card, tag outline, character slot dotted border. 3.5:1 on bg-100.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Milky white. Headlines and body copy on bg-100, bg-200, bg-300 (≥15:1).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy: card descriptions, captions under numbers, on bg-100/200/300 (≥7.8:1).

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Service labels only: footer captions, slide counter, coordinates. On bg-100/200 (≥4.8:1); keep off bg-300 for small text.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The ONE accent: key words in headlines, big numbers, card kicker labels, the '.ai' in the wordmark, CTA keyword. Typography only — never a filled plate.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Powder blue: character LED details, thin UI schematics, secondary highlight inside body copy.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: Confidence bar fills, cursor, active node in a schema. Marks, not text.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Caution lead-in inside a note ('Осторожно с рекламой:') and the 'что возможно' risk label. Rare: max once per slide.

families.display: Oswald, "Bebas Neue", "Arial Narrow", "Helvetica Neue Condensed", sans-serif

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: THE headline — one size on every slide (cover included). Uppercase, 2–4 lines, always directly under the kicker at the same top position. Never scaled up or down per slide.

styles.name: display-m
styles.usage: Big numbers in stat cards (in accent).

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Row labels, step names, comparison card names. Uppercase.

styles.name: body-l
styles.sample: 21 сентября вышла модель Jev. Она отвечает не абзацем, а готовым решением.
styles.usage: Lead text on explainer slides; 2–4 lines max.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Список вариантов задаёте вы. Модель не может ответить того, чего в списке нет.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Captions under numbers, row descriptions, in ink-muted.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Kicker above a headline and card kickers, uppercase, in accent.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Header counter, footer captions, coordinates, uppercase, in ink-faint.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The wordmark, top-left of every slide: 'nikolskaya' in ink, '.ai' in accent, lowercase.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between label and its text; bar row gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a grid; kicker-to-headline gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inside small cards (tags, rows) vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Headline to content block; section breathing room.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Slide safe margin (left/right/top/bottom) at 1080 × 1350.

tokens.name: grid-step
tokens.usage: Background grid pitch (1080 / 20). Crosses '+' sit on its intersections.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Rows, stat cards, text cards inside a slide.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Large content panels (comparison columns, chart panel).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: The outer slide container — the digital-interface card.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Tags.

tokens.name: shadow-glow
tokens.usage: Halo behind the central object (character, laptop, interface). Never on cards.

tokens.name: slide-w
tokens.usage: Instagram 4:5 slide width.

tokens.name: slide-h
tokens.usage: Instagram 4:5 slide height.
